next_measurement_request.data_rules: coded, non-personal identifiers only; no donor, patient or personal information

items.request: For each workbook column B:Q, state whether all values come from one physical device or well measured on successive days, and give a coded device/well identifier per cell.
For each column, give coded experiment-batch and cell-lot labels so independent replicates can be counted.

For each blank cell, state whether it was not scheduled, not measured, or excluded, and the exclusion rule. Cervix Chip: 36 cells (B3, C3, D3, E3, F3, G3, B4, C4, D4, E4, F4, E5, I5, C6, E6, I6, C7, E7, H7, C8, D8, H8, B9, C9, D9, E9, F9, G9, C10, G10, H10, B11, E11, G11, H11, I11); Transwell: 36 cells (N3, O3, P3, Q3, O4, P4, Q4, J5, K5, L5, M5, N5, O5, P5, Q5, P7, Q7, M8, N8, O8, P8, Q8, M9, N9, O9, P9, Q9, M10, N10, O10, P10, Q10, J11, K11, P11, Q11)

items.missing_evidence: independent reference on a shared time origin
items.request: Per group, designate a pre-specified reference set of series, distinct from candidate series, measured on the same source-day schedule (-3 to 5) with the same TEER instrument, electrode, blank subtraction and area correction.
Any recorded per-cell measurement events (electrode fault, bubble, temperature, medium-change timing) if they exist.
Unit and normalization reference for the Fig. 3h series before they can be included.
